toolchain.note_on_v1_manifest_toolchain_typo: In v1 `remediation-c924bebf-manifest.json` and `batch3b-manifest.json`, the packaging script had a hardcoded string (`Swift 6.3` / `24B74`) instead of invoking `xcrun swift -version` and `xcrun --sdk iphonesimulator --show-sdk-build-version`. As shown in `pilot-manifest.json` and `logs/remediation_c924bebf_build_for_testing.stdout.txt`, the actual compiler and SDK used by `Xcode 27.1 (27A9275)` are `Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)` and `iphonesimulator27.1 (24A94232)`.

m04_extra_probe.explanation: In the intermediate run (step 1869 / task-1871 at ~15:35+08:00), `test-without-building` wrote to the same `remediation-c924bebf-audit/test.stdout` and `remediation-c924bebf-audit/ui.xcresult` paths that were subsequently `shutil.rmtree`d and overwritten by the 15-method run (step 1920 / task-1921 at 15:42+08:00). Therefore, the raw `test.stdout` and `ui.xcresult` from that intermediate probe were not preserved and cannot be independently verified from archived raw files (`未保留 / 无法核实`). Per instruction, no re-run was performed and no `maximumSwipes: 10` modification was executed.

g05_v2_to_v3_correction_note: In `remediation-c924bebf-manifest-v2.json`, items #19-#27 were inadvertently re-typed when the console preview of the v1 packaging script truncated after item #18, causing items #21 and #22 (`12-1-f998b51f...png` and `12-2-f998b51f...png`, both sharing SHA-256 `f998b51f4e7cb71a522eb2bdfe63df9109e0de59218e90dbfb0fcaae5f222767` and Git blob `52538ee0edf85b331400fac1fbddc1003d5d9af6`) to receive conflicting descriptions/verdicts and shifting the verdicts of #22-#25. In v3, all 27 items restore their exact original v1 visual audit verdicts and pixel-verified descriptions (where #13, #21, #22, and #24 are the 4 `PASS_WITH_MINOR_SCROLL_NOTE` items, and #20, #23, #25 are `PASS`), with only the `(slice, after_blob)` prefix updated programmatically.
